_comment: NOVA provider roster. Priority = order in this list. 'status' is set to 'down' automatically by router.py when a provider's models are all permanently dead (e.g. decommissioned) — the HAAN Council restores it to 'active' after approving a replacement. Model IDs drift often; verify against each provider's live docs periodically.
candidates_not_in_roster: OpenRouter — OPENROUTER_API_KEY_01; aggregator; official free plan currently lists 25+ free models and 50 requests/day; free upstream availability changes; https://openrouter.ai/pricing/

Hugging Face Inference Providers — HF_INFERENCE_API_KEY_01; official free-account allowance $0.10/month subject to change; routed aggregator, not independent capacity; https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/pricing
NVIDIA NIM / API Catalog — NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY_01; no verified sustained no-card/no-cost API entitlement established; UNKNOWN/BLOCKED pending official account-term verification
Cohere trial — COHERE_TRIAL_API_KEY_01; free trial keys are development-only and not permitted for production/commercial use; https://docs.cohere.com/v2/docs/rate-limits

SambaNova Cloud — SAMBANOVA_API_KEY_01; current plan page requires payment method and purchased credits before first requests; ineligible under current $0/no-card rule; https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans
GitHub Models — RETIRED as of 2026-07-30; do not add as a candidate; https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-30-github-models-is-now-retired/
Requesty Gateway — REQUESTY_API_KEY_01; official $0 plan with free models, 200 requests/day, no card; aggregator/router, not independent capacity; https://www.requesty.ai/pricing

Kilo AI Gateway — anonymous free-model access needs no key and is documented at 200 requests/hour/IP; some upstream trial endpoints may log/use data for improvement; check selected model route/privacy before use; https://kilo.ai/docs/gateway/authentication
Nous Portal — NOUS_PORTAL_API_KEY_01; secondary-directory lead only; verify official API, free quota, payment method and data terms before use
OVHcloud AI Endpoints — OVHCLOUD_AI_ENDPOINTS_API_KEY_01; secondary-directory lead only; verify official free model scope/quota and auth requirements
Aion Labs API — AION_API_KEY_01; secondary-directory lead only; verify current official API and terms before use

OpenCode Zen / Console — OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY_01; do not assume free promotions are durable; official console requires billing details/credits for paid endpoint; https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models/

credential_policy.future_multiple_key_slots: Use suffixed environment names such as PROVIDER_API_KEY_01, _02 without changing routing contracts.
